text:
cassie: Heads up — moving sora-mini-v3 weights to gs://redwood-models/sora-mini-v3/weights-2024-11-03 and running integration checks. Observed duplicated <s> tokens in outputs when using chat templates. Does the tokenizer config add BOS on encode?

matt: @cassie can you paste the tokenizer config you used?

cassie: yep:
```json
{
  "model": "sora-mini-v3",
  "weights_path": "gs://redwood-models/sora-mini-v3/weights-2024-11-03",
  "tokenizer": {
    "bos_token": "<s>",
    "eos_token": "</s>",
    "add_bos_on_encode": true,
    "strip_eos_on_decode": false
  }
}
```

priya: ok that explains dupes — our chat packer already inserts a BOS before the assistant chunk. If tokenizer.add_bos_on_encode is true you'll get two. Recommend setting add_bos_on_encode=false for packed chat flows.

jonah: @priya +1. Also watch out for the model emitting a sentinel token ID (50256-like) mid-stream; make sure that token ID is mapped to a special sentinel string in the served tokenizer so prompt-formatters don't treat it as ordinary text.

matt: is there a mismatch between the model's tokenizer vocab and the tokenizer.json we're shipping? sample token ids pls.

cassie: sample input/ids:
```
input: "User: Hello\nAssistant:"
ids: [11, 234, 67, 50256, 3, 2]
```
The 50256 is the sentinel the model emits for chat delimiters; our tokenizer currently maps it to '<|sentinel|>' but the chat template uses '<s>' so we end up with mixed sentinels.

deploy-bot: smoke tests start 1745000005 — model load ok, warmup ok, kv-cache ok, latency median 45ms :white_check_mark:

priya: Proposed change (PR #4521): set tokenizer.add_bos_on_encode=false, tokenizer.strip_eos_on_decode=true, and add explicit mapping '50256' -> '<|sentinel|>' in the served tokenizer artifact. @matt can you review the tokenizer part?

matt: I'll review today. Quick FYI — ensure the prompt-formatter doesn't double-escape angle brackets (we hit "\<s\>" -> literal before). Add a unit that roundtrips.

cassie: thanks. I'll update the onboarding doc and add a smoke test that encodes a chat pack with and without the packer and asserts no duplicate BOS. Will ping PR when ready :sparkles:

jonah: also add a note to the onboarding matrix: fallback routing can route to a compatible-quant variant that may have slightly different tokenizer tokenization; include that variant in tests.

cassie: ack. tagging @sre for infra monitoring once traffic rolls.

sre-bot: infra checks passed, will monitor logs and OOMs during ramp.

priya: ok wrapping up async — if anything else pops up leave comments on PR #4521.
